title: HELIX Bridge: Workday HCM → Position Management
architecture_notes: Workday uses position management as a core organizational building block. Every job assignment sits in a position, and every position sits in a supervisory organization. Positions define the 'seat' (job profile, location, compensation grade, etc.) independently of who fills it. This differs from PeopleSoft where position management is optional (many PS clients use department/job code without formal positions).

source_objects.description: Position definition: title, job profile, supervisory org, location, availability date, compensation grade, worker type. Equivalent to PS_POSITION_DATA.
Budget and headcount constraints on positions. Equivalent to PS_POSITION_DATA budget fields.
Hierarchical org unit. The primary org structure in Workday. Positions belong to supervisory orgs, not departments. Equivalent to PS_DEPT_TBL (loosely).
Template defining a job: title, job family, job level, pay rate type, management level, FLSA status. Equivalent to PS_JOBCODE_TBL.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Position-specific title if overridden, otherwise from job profile.
Workday Job Profile = PS Job Code. The classification template.
Grouping of related job profiles. E.g., 'Information Technology', 'Faculty - Arts & Sciences'.
Map to institutional level structure or HELIX level codes.
The org unit this position reports into.

attribute_mappings.source: Position.Cost_Center (worktag) or supervisory org → cost center

attribute_mappings.transformation: Resolve to HELIX employee_id if position is filled.
Number of workers that can fill this position (usually 1).
Map to IPEDS EEO category for federal reporting. E.g., 'Executive/Admin/Managerial', 'Faculty', 'Professional', 'Clerical', 'Technical', 'Skilled Craft', 'Service/Maintenance'.

attribute_mappings.source: Position.Fund (worktag) or default from supervisory org
attribute_mappings.transformation: Map to HELIX fund code. Faculty positions on grants → restricted fund.
